zh: \(J_c\) 与 \(J_\Lambda\) 都由 \(e^{-d}\)、\(e^{-4d}\) 显式积分，因而在整个 heat path 上有限。该 homogeneous \(X_g\) theorem 明确要求 \(F_q=0\)、\(\mu>0\)、\(0<g\le1\)；它不外推成 kinetic norm 的 \(A_2\) 速率。
en: Both \(J_c\) and \(J_\Lambda\) are explicit integrals of \(e^{-d}\) and \(e^{-4d}\), so they remain finite along the entire heat path. This homogeneous \(X_g\) theorem explicitly requires \(F_q=0\), \(\mu>0\), and \(0<g\le1\); it is not extrapolated to an \(A_2\) rate in the kinetic norm.

zh: 对每个 fixed nonzero \(\Lambda\)，充分小的 \(\mu\) 都出现严格 instantaneous kinetic growth。这个 witness 由两个方向组成，不应误称为只含两个 Fourier modes。
en: For every fixed nonzero \(\Lambda\), sufficiently small \(\mu\) yields strict instantaneous kinetic growth. This witness uses two directions and should not be misdescribed as containing only two Fourier modes.

en: I compress the near-zero Bloch carrier singularity into an orientation factor,

en: I select the zero-lattice carrier on the half-open Bloch cell \([-1/2,1/2)\). At the included endpoint \(\beta=-1/2\), the lowest eigenvalue has multiplicity two, so only a selected carrier is claimed, not a unique slow mode.

zh: 无限维结论由 energy identity、operator-norm tail bound、Gronwall 与 direct-sum argument 承担。证书复核精确代数和绑定的 finite rows；附图展示已审计公式和有限诊断，不构成证明。
en: The infinite-dimensional conclusions are carried by the energy identity, operator-norm tail bound, Gronwall argument, and direct-sum argument. The certificate rechecks exact algebra and the bound finite rows; the figure displays audited formulas and finite diagnostics and is not a proof.

zh: 下一节比较 exact lift-up lower bound、triangular low-gap limit 与可构造的 polynomial upper mechanism；只有在 \(|\Lambda|\) 依赖清楚后，才尝试 complete OS--Squire \(A_2\) direct sum。
en: The next section compares the exact lift-up lower bound, the triangular low-gap limit, and a constructible polynomial upper-bound mechanism. Only after the \(|\Lambda|\) dependence is clear will a complete OS--Squire \(A_2\) direct sum be attempted.

zh: 严格增量是：near-carrier inverse gap 被物理方向吸收；完整 velocity/Squire rows 获得可求和的有限 transient；fixed-\(c\) singular path 与 fixed-\(\Lambda\) path 被分开。A2-scale pressure modulation、nonlinear frequency transfer、vortex stretching 和 continuation criterion 都未闭合。
en: The rigorous increments are that the near-carrier inverse gap is absorbed by physical orientation, the complete velocity/Squire rows acquire a summable finite transient, and the fixed-\(c\) singular path is separated from the fixed-\(\Lambda\) path. A2-scale pressure modulation, nonlinear frequency transfer, vortex stretching, and the continuation criterion remain unclosed.

en: The deterministic screen contains 280 propagators, 1960 primary norm rows, and 245 targeted rows. zh: fixed \(\Lambda\) 与 fixed \(c\) 是不同的低间隙命题

zh: fixed bounded \(\Lambda\) 时，physical kinetic propagator 在 \(\mu\downarrow0\) 保持有限。fixed nonzero \(c\) 时，\(\Lambda=c/\sqrt\mu\)，由 regular-system continuity 与非零低模投影得到至少 \(C\mu^{-1/2}\) 的 kinetic growth。因此 fixedCUniformLowGapKineticPropagator=FALSE。
en: For fixed bounded \(\Lambda\), the physical kinetic propagator remains finite as \(\mu\downarrow0\). For fixed nonzero \(c\), \(\Lambda=c/\sqrt\mu\), and regular-system continuity together with a nonzero low-mode projection gives kinetic growth of at least \(C\mu^{-1/2}\). Therefore fixedCUniformLowGapKineticPropagator=FALSE.

zh: integrated low-gap coefficient 为 \(0.188106027072\ldots\)，小于 elementary all-row coefficient \(5/16\)。它是 logarithmic-norm limit，不是 exact maximum transient gain。
en: The integrated low-gap coefficient is \(0.188106027072\ldots\), below the elementary all-row coefficient \(5/16\). It is a logarithmic-norm limit, not an exact maximum transient gain.

zh: lambdaIndependentKineticPrefactor=FALSE；fixedCUniformLowGapKineticPropagator=FALSE；allRowPrefactorOneKineticContraction=FALSE。fixed \(c\ne0\) 对应 \(|\Lambda|=|c|/\sqrt\mu\to\infty\)，不能与 fixed \(\Lambda\) 混写。
en: lambdaIndependentKineticPrefactor=FALSE; fixedCUniformLowGapKineticPropagator=FALSE; allRowPrefactorOneKineticContraction=FALSE. Fixed \(c\ne0\) corresponds to \(|\Lambda|=|c|/\sqrt\mu\to\infty\) and must not be conflated with fixed \(\Lambda\).

en: Primitive components cover the exceptional rows with \(\mu=0\); when \(\mu>0\), the identity agrees with the exact Orr--Sommerfeld--Squire kinetic identity.

zh: zero-lattice Bloch carrier 的精确抵消把耦合侧的 \(g^{-1}\) 化为 \(\omega=2\gamma\beta/g\)，满足 \(|\omega|\le1\)。更重要的是，primitive velocity kinetic energy 直接覆盖 Orr--Sommerfeld、Squire 与 exceptional rows，并在 viscous row rate 上无行数损失地求和。A2、sharp \(|\Lambda|\) law、nonlinear 与 Clay 仍为 OPEN。
en: The exact zero-lattice Bloch carrier cancellation turns the coupling-side \(g^{-1}\) into \(\omega=2\gamma\beta/g\), with \(|\omega|\le1\). More importantly, primitive velocity kinetic energy directly covers Orr--Sommerfeld, Squire, and exceptional rows and sums them at the viscous row rate with no row-count loss. A2, the sharp \(|\Lambda|\) law, nonlinear closure, and Clay remain OPEN.

en: R0.73B closes the exact Bloch near-carrier cancellation and complete linear physical-kinetic finite transient. The next gate is the sharp large-\(|\Lambda|\) transient law.

zh: R0.73B 由 exact Bloch carrier cancellation 得到 bounded physical orientation，并用 primitive kinetic identity 闭合 complete linear velocity/Squire rows 的 finite transient direct sum。fixed-\(c\) uniformity 与 prefactor-one contraction 为 FALSE；A2、sharp \(|\Lambda|\)、nonlinear 与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: R0.73B obtains a bounded physical orientation from the exact Bloch carrier cancellation and uses the primitive kinetic identity to close the finite-transient direct sum for the complete linear velocity/Squire rows. Fixed-\(c\) uniformity and prefactor-one contraction are FALSE; A2, the sharp \(|\Lambda|\) law, nonlinear closure, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: zero-lattice Bloch carrier 的 exact cancellation 把 coupling-side \(g^{-1}\) 化为 bounded physical orientation；primitive velocity energy 再覆盖 OS、Squire 与 exceptional rows。
en: The exact zero-lattice Bloch carrier cancellation turns the coupling-side \(g^{-1}\) into a bounded physical orientation; primitive velocity energy then covers the OS, Squire, and exceptional rows.
